	local RE = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RE", 10)
	if not RE then return end

	local NameRemote = RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eTex1t")
	local ColorRemote = RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eColo1r")

	if NameRemote then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			pcall(function()
				NameRemote:FireServer("RolePlayName", "👑RTG V3👑")
				NameRemote:FireServer("RolePlayBio", "WELCOME MR " .. player.Name .. "DOST 👽✌️")
			end)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end

	-- RGB Color Loop for Name + Bio
	if ColorRemote then
		while true do
			local c = Color3.fromHSV((tick() % 5) / 5, 1, 1)
			pcall(function()
				ColorRemote:FireServer("PickingRPNameColor", c)
				ColorRemote:FireServer("PickingRPBioColor", c)
			end)
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end
end)

local function draggable(frame,handle)  
	local dragging = false  
	local dragStart  
	local startPos  
  
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)  
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then  
  
			dragging = true  
			dragStart = input.Position  
			startPos = frame.Position  
  
			input.Changed:Connect(function()  
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then  
					dragging = false  
				end  
			end)  
		end  
	end)  
  
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)  
		if dragging and (  
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch  
		) then  
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart  
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(  
				startPos.X.Scale,  
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,  
				startPos.Y.Scale,  
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y  
			)  
		end  
	end)  
end

scripts.script:
local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace          = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService  = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UserInputService   = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService       = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui   = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local WeaponControllerFolder = ReplicatedStorage
    :WaitForChild("CORE")
    :WaitForChild("Controllers")
    :WaitForChild("WeaponController")

local WeaponState = require(WeaponControllerFolder:WaitForChild("WeaponState"))
local FireSystem  = require(WeaponControllerFolder:WaitForChild("FireSystem"))
local AimAssist   = require(WeaponControllerFolder:WaitForChild("AimAssist"))

local Knit = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Knit)
local WeaponController = Knit.GetController("WeaponController")

local Packets = require(
    ReplicatedStorage
        :WaitForChild("CORE")
        :WaitForChild("Network")
        :WaitForChild("Packets")
)

local CONFIG = {
    Enabled          = true,
    FOV              = 300,
    AimCone          = 180,
    FullCircle       = true,
    TargetHead       = true,
    TargetPlayers    = true,
    TargetBots       = true,
    TargetTeam       = false,
    AliveCheck       = true,
    IgnoreForceField = false,
    OnScreenCheck    = true,
    VisibleCheck     = true,
    Keybind          = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,

    TriggerbotEnabled    = false,
    TriggerbotKeybind    = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
    TriggerbotRequireLMB = false,
    TriggerbotMinDelay   = 0.20,

    AutoReloadThreshold  = 1,
    AutoReloadCooldown   = 1.5,

    AutoRespawn          = true,
    AutoRespawnDelay     = 0,
    AutoRespawnKeybind   = Enum.KeyCode.Backspace,

    RestoreDeathPosition = true,
    RestoreDelay         = 0.15,

    ESPEnabled     = true,
    ESPFill        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
    ESPOutline     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    ESPText        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    ESPTextStroke  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    ESPLabel       = "LUCKY BLOCK",
}

local SilentAimEnabled  = CONFIG.Enabled
local TriggerbotEnabled = CONFIG.TriggerbotEnabled

local function GetCamera()
    return Workspace.CurrentCamera
end

local function BuildUI()
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name            = "SilentAimUI"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn    = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset  = true
    gui.ZIndexBehavior  = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Parent          = PlayerGui

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    frame.Position               = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12)
    frame.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 200)
    frame.BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    frame.BorderSizePixel        = 0
    frame.Parent                 = gui

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = frame

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color        = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
    stroke.Thickness    = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.4
    stroke.Parent       = frame

    local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    padding.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 8)
    padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
    padding.PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 10)
    padding.PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 10)
    padding.Parent        = frame

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.FillDirection       = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    layout.VerticalAlignment   = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
    layout.SortOrder           = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding             = UDim.new(0, 4)
    layout.Parent              = frame

    local aimStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    aimStatus.Name                   = "AimStatus"
    aimStatus.LayoutOrder            = 1
    aimStatus.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    aimStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    aimStatus.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    aimStatus.TextSize               = 15
    aimStatus.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    aimStatus.Text                   = "Silent Aim: ON"
    aimStatus.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
    aimStatus.Parent                 = frame

    local trigStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    trigStatus.Name                   = "TrigStatus"
    trigStatus.LayoutOrder            = 2
    trigStatus.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    trigStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    trigStatus.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    trigStatus.TextSize               = 15
    trigStatus.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    trigStatus.Text                   = "Triggerbot: OFF"
    trigStatus.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
    trigStatus.Parent                 = frame

    local respawnStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    respawnStatus.Name                   = "RespawnStatus"
    respawnStatus.LayoutOrder            = 3
    respawnStatus.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    respawnStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    respawnStatus.Font                   = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    respawnStatus.TextSize               = 15
    respawnStatus.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    respawnStatus.Text                   = "Auto-Respawn: ON"
    respawnStatus.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
    respawnStatus.Parent                 = frame

    local hintLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hintLabel.Name                   = "Hint"
    hintLabel.LayoutOrder            = 4
    hintLabel.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    hintLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hintLabel.Font                   = Enum.Font.Gotham
    hintLabel.TextSize               = 10
    hintLabel.TextWrapped            = true
    hintLabel.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    hintLabel.TextColor3             = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    hintLabel.Text                   = "RightShift / RightControl / Backspace to toggle"
    hintLabel.Parent                 = frame

    local aimBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    aimBtn.Name             = "AimBtn"
    aimBtn.LayoutOrder      = 5
    aimBtn.Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
    aimBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 60)
    aimBtn.BorderSizePixel  = 0
    aimBtn.AutoButtonColor  = true
    aimBtn.Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    aimBtn.TextSize         = 13
    aimBtn.TextColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    aimBtn.Text             = "TOGGLE SILENT AIM"
    aimBtn.Parent           = frame

    local aimBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    aimBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    aimBtnCorner.Parent = aimBtn

    local trigBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    trigBtn.Name             = "TrigBtn"
    trigBtn.LayoutOrder      = 6
    trigBtn.Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
    trigBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
    trigBtn.BorderSizePixel  = 0
    trigBtn.AutoButtonColor  = true
    trigBtn.Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    trigBtn.TextSize         = 13
    trigBtn.TextColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    trigBtn.Text             = "TOGGLE TRIGGERBOT"
    trigBtn.Parent           = frame

    local trigBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    trigBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    trigBtnCorner.Parent = trigBtn

    return {
        gui = gui, frame = frame,
        aimStatus = aimStatus, trigStatus = trigStatus,
        respawnStatus = respawnStatus,
        hint = hintLabel, aimBtn = aimBtn, trigBtn = trigBtn,
    }
end

local UI = BuildUI()

local function RefreshUI()
    if SilentAimEnabled then
        UI.aimStatus.Text          = "Silent Aim: ON"
        UI.aimStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
        UI.aimBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 60)
    else
        UI.aimStatus.Text          = "Silent Aim: OFF"
        UI.aimStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        UI.aimBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
    end

    if TriggerbotEnabled then
        UI.trigStatus.Text          = "Triggerbot: ON"
        UI.trigStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
        UI.trigBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 60)
    else
        UI.trigStatus.Text          = "Triggerbot: OFF"
        UI.trigStatus.TextColor3    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        UI.trigBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
    end

    if CONFIG.AutoRespawn then
        UI.respawnStatus.Text       = "Auto-Respawn: ON"
        UI.respawnStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 100)
    else
        UI.respawnStatus.Text       = "Auto-Respawn: OFF"
        UI.respawnStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
    end
end

local function SetSilentAim(state)
    SilentAimEnabled = state
    RefreshUI()
end

local function SetTriggerbot(state)
    TriggerbotEnabled = state
    RefreshUI()
end

local function ToggleAutoRespawn()
    CONFIG.AutoRespawn = not CONFIG.AutoRespawn
    RefreshUI()
end

UI.aimBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    SetSilentAim(not SilentAimEnabled)
end)

UI.trigBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    SetTriggerbot(not TriggerbotEnabled)
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == CONFIG.Keybind then
        SetSilentAim(not SilentAimEnabled)
    elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.TriggerbotKeybind then
        SetTriggerbot(not TriggerbotEnabled)
    elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.AutoRespawnKeybind then
        ToggleAutoRespawn()
    end
end)

RefreshUI()

local function GetTeam(inst)
    return inst:GetAttribute("RoundTeam")
end

local function IsEnemyPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if CONFIG.TargetTeam then return true end

    local myTeam, theirTeam = GetTeam(LocalPlayer), GetTeam(player)
    if myTeam == nil or theirTeam == nil then return true end
    return myTeam ~= theirTeam
end

local function IsEnemyBot(bot)
    if CONFIG.TargetTeam then return true end
    local myTeam, theirTeam = GetTeam(LocalPlayer), GetTeam(bot)
    if myTeam == nil or theirTeam == nil then return true end
    return myTeam ~= theirTeam
end

local function HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return true end

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType  = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local filter = { cam }
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(filter, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    local we = Workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponEffects")
    if we then table.insert(filter, we) end

    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter

    local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPart.Position - origin, params)
    if not hit then return true end
    return hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function IsOnScreen(worldPos)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return false end
    local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
    if not onScreen then return false end
    if screenPos.Z <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

local function ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, character, targetPart, best)
    if not targetPart then return best end

    if CONFIG.AliveCheck then
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return best end
    end

    if not CONFIG.IgnoreForceField then
        if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return best end
    end

    local dir  = targetPart.Position - origin
    local dist = dir.Magnitude

    if dist <= 0.1 or dist > CONFIG.FOV then return best end

    local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(lookUnit:Dot(dir.Unit), -1, 1))

    if not CONFIG.FullCircle then
        if angle >= math.rad(CONFIG.AimCone) then return best end
        if CONFIG.OnScreenCheck and not IsOnScreen(targetPart.Position) then return best end
    end

    if CONFIG.VisibleCheck and not HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character) then return best end

    local score
    if CONFIG.FullCircle then
        score = dist
    else
        score = angle * 10 + dist * 0.01
    end

    if not best or score < best.score then
        return { part = targetPart, score = score }
    end
    return best
end

local function GatherBots()
    local seen = {}
    local out  = {}

    local function add(m)
        if not m or seen[m] then return end
        if not m:IsA("Model") then return end
        if m:HasTag("RagdollRig") then return end
        if not m:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return end
        seen[m] = true
        table.insert(out, m)
    end

    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("Bot") do add(v) end
    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("NPC") do add(v) end

    for _, v in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
        if v:IsA("Model") and v:GetAttribute("IsBot") == true then
            add(v)
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function GetBestTarget(origin, lookUnit)
    local best = nil

    if CONFIG.TargetPlayers then
        for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
            if IsEnemyPlayer(player) then
                local char = player.Character
                if char then
                    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local part = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp
                    best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, char, part, best)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if CONFIG.TargetBots then
        for _, bot in GatherBots() do
            if IsEnemyBot(bot) then
                local head  = bot:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local hrp   = bot:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local torso = bot:FindFirstChild("Torso") or bot:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                local part  = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp or torso
                best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, bot, part, best)
            end
        end
    end

    return best and best.part or nil
end

local originalApply = AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism

AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism = function(origin, direction, isAiming)
    if not SilentAimEnabled then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude <= 0 then return direction end

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, direction.Unit)
    if not target then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local toTarget = target.Position - origin
    if toTarget.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
        return direction
    end

    return toTarget.Unit * magnitude
end

local originalFireRequestSend = Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send

Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send = function(payload)
    if SilentAimEnabled and payload and payload.Origin and payload.Direction then
        local magnitude = payload.Direction.Magnitude
        if magnitude > 0 then
            local target = GetBestTarget(payload.Origin, payload.Direction.Unit)
            if target then
                payload = {
                    ShotId    = payload.ShotId,
                    Origin    = payload.Origin,
                    Direction = (target.Position - payload.Origin).Unit * magnitude,
                    FireTime  = payload.FireTime,
                }
            end
        end
    end
    return originalFireRequestSend(payload)
end

local lastTriggerFire       = 0
local lastAutoReloadAttempt = 0

local function PrimeFire()
    local prev = WeaponState.MouseDown
    WeaponState.MouseDown = true
    local ok, err = pcall(FireSystem.PerformFire)
    WeaponState.MouseDown = prev or false
    if not ok then
        warn("[Triggerbot] PerformFire error:", err)
    end
end

local function TriggerbotStep()
    if not TriggerbotEnabled or not SilentAimEnabled then return end
    if not WeaponState.CurrentConfig then return end
    if os.clock() < WeaponState.FirstTimeEquipUntil then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold
        and not WeaponState.IsReloading then

        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastAutoReloadAttempt >= CONFIG.AutoReloadCooldown then
            lastAutoReloadAttempt = now
            if WeaponController and WeaponController.Reload then
                pcall(function()
                    WeaponController:Reload()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if WeaponState.IsReloading then return end
    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold then return end

    if CONFIG.TriggerbotRequireLMB
        and not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastTriggerFire < CONFIG.TriggerbotMinDelay then return end

    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return end

    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local look   = cam.CFrame.LookVector

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, look)
    if not target then return end

    lastTriggerFire = now
    PrimeFire()
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(TriggerbotStep)

local respawnBusy         = false
local savedDeathCFrame    = nil
local restoreToken        = 0

local function RespawnNow()
    if not CONFIG.AutoRespawn then return end
    if respawnBusy then return end
    respawnBusy = true

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        GameService:RespawnInRound()
    end)

    if not ok then
        warn("[AutoRespawn] RespawnInRound error:", err)
    end

    task.delay(1, function()
        respawnBusy = false
    end)
end

local function RestoreDeathPosition(char)
    if not CONFIG.RestoreDeathPosition then return end
    if not savedDeathCFrame then return end

    restoreToken = restoreToken + 1
    local myToken = restoreToken
    local cframe = savedDeathCFrame
    savedDeathCFrame = nil

    task.spawn(function()
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not hrp then return end

        task.wait(CONFIG.RestoreDelay)

        if myToken ~= restoreToken then return end
        if LocalPlayer.Character ~= char then return end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

        hrp.CFrame = cframe

        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        if myToken ~= restoreToken then return end
        if LocalPlayer.Character ~= char then return end
        if not hrp.Parent then return end

        local snapped = (hrp.Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude > 5
        if snapped then
            hrp.CFrame = cframe
        end
    end)
end

local function HookCharacter(char)
    if not char then return end

    RestoreDeathPosition(char)

    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if not hum then return end

    hum.Died:Connect(function()
        if CONFIG.RestoreDeathPosition then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                savedDeathCFrame = hrp.CFrame
            end
        end

        if not CONFIG.AutoRespawn then return end

        if CONFIG.AutoRespawnDelay > 0 then
            task.delay(CONFIG.AutoRespawnDelay, RespawnNow)
        else
            task.defer(RespawnNow)
        end
    end)
end

local function SlideInAlone()
    if aloneVisible then return end
    aloneVisible = true
    aloneHideToken = aloneHideToken + 1

    TweenService:Create(
        AloneLabel,
        TweenInfo.new(ALONE_SLIDE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        { Position = ALONE_ON_X }
    ):Play()

    local myToken = aloneHideToken
    task.delay(ALONE_HOLD, function()
        if myToken ~= aloneHideToken then return end
        if not aloneVisible then return end

        TweenService:Create(
            AloneLabel,
            TweenInfo.new(ALONE_SLIDE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { Position = ALONE_OFF_X }
        ):Play()

        aloneVisible = false
    end)
end

local function IsLocalPlayerAlone()
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local aloneDebounce = false

local function CheckAlone()
    if IsLocalPlayerAlone() then

            SlideInAlone()
        end
    else
        aloneDebounce = false
    end
end

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Coin Farm, Auto Ski and Auto Quest + More
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for a Roblox ski game uses FishyUI and opens with RightAlt, attaching to the game's own live client modules so it drives the same ski state and run flow the game steps every frame. Auto coin farm routes the body coin to coin while keeping the run alive, with two movement modes: teleport, which writes CFrame straight onto each coin (no collision sweep, so nothing to hit on the way), and glide, which steps under the game's broad-phase band so the swept grab segment picks up whatever lies between coins. It reopens runs when they drop, clicks the game's own continue prompt after a wreck to skip the twenty-second timeout, and cycles the run once the server's per-run payout cap is reached. Quest handling ranks all roughly forty rotation quests, holds the six the farm can actually finish (coin, score, airtime, maxair, survive), swaps out ones it can't drive, and asks for finished ones — while skipping kinds like trick, ring and wallride that need input the farm never makes, and distance quests the server won't credit for a teleport. Live panels show ski state, credited coins, picked up, coins per minute, run count, quests held, quests completed, and XP, alongside a log of key events. Anti-AFK keeps the client from idling out, and a settings tab documents the game's own numbers — grab radius, stuck watchdog, run cap, and quest slots — plus whether live tables were verified. Theme and config saving work through FishyUI's addons but degrade gracefully if either is missing.

SKI, SKI ALPHA

        local CONFIG = {

            function(cf)

            end,
            function(cf)
                return cf * CFrame.new(0, -CONFIG.OFFSET_DISTANCE, 0)

            end,

            end,
            function(cf)
                return cf * CFrame.new(0, CONFIG.OFFSET_DISTANCE, CONFIG.OFFSET_DISTANCE)
            end,
            function(cf)
                return cf * CFrame.new(0, CONFIG.OFFSET_DISTANCE, -CONFIG.OFFSET_DISTANCE)
            end,
        }

        local function isValidTarget(player)
            if player == LocalPlayer then
                return false
            end

            local character = player.Character
            if not character then
                return false
            end

            return character:FindFirstChild("isInArena")
                and character.isInArena.Value
                and not character:FindFirstChild("FakePart Left Leg")
                and not character:FindFirstChild("rock")
                and not BannedPlayers[player]
        end

        local function getRandomTarget()
            local validPlayers = {}
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if isValidTarget(player) then
                    table.insert(validPlayers, player)
                end
            end

            return #validPlayers > 0 and validPlayers[math.random(1, #validPlayers)] or nil
        end

        local function stopAllUnions()
            for union, thread in pairs(ActiveCoroutines) do
                if type(thread) == "thread" then
                    coroutine.close(thread)
                end
                if union and union:IsA("UnionOperation") then
                    union.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end

            table.clear(ActiveCoroutines)
            table.clear(ActiveUnions)
            table.clear(BannedPlayers)
        end

        local function moveUnionErratically(union)
            while _G.UnioningPlayers do
                local targetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
                if not targetPlayer then
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    continue
                end

                local character = targetPlayer.Character
                local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not humanoidRootPart then
                    continue
                end

                while _G.UnioningPlayers and isValidTarget(targetPlayer) do
                    local getRandomPosition = OFFSET_POSITIONS[math.random(1, #OFFSET_POSITIONS)]
                    local targetCFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame

                    local newCFrame = getRandomPosition(targetCFrame)
                    local newPosition = newCFrame.Position

                    local direction = (newPosition - union.Position)
                    union.Velocity = direction.Unit * CONFIG.MOVEMENT_SPEED

                    task.wait(CONFIG.TELEPORT_INTERVAL)
                end

                if _G.UnioningPlayers then
                    BannedPlayers[targetPlayer] = true
                    task.delay(CONFIG.PLAYER_BAN_TIME, function()
                        BannedPlayers[targetPlayer] = nil
                    end)

                    union.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
            end

            if union and union:IsA("UnionOperation") then
                union.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end

        local function startTrackingUnion(union)
            if not ActiveUnions[union] and _G.UnioningPlayers then
                ActiveUnions[union] = true
                ActiveCoroutines[union] = task.spawn(function()
                    moveUnionErratically(union)
                end)
            end
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local lastState = _G.UnioningPlayers
            while true do
                if lastState ~= _G.UnioningPlayers then
                    if _G.UnioningPlayers then
                        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                            if obj:IsA("UnionOperation") and not obj.Anchored then
                                startTrackingUnion(obj)
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        stopAllUnions()
                    end
                    lastState = _G.UnioningPlayers
                end
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end)

        Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("UnionOperation") and not child.Anchored and _G.UnioningPlayers then
                startTrackingUnion(child)
            end
        end)

        Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("UnionOperation") then
                ActiveUnions[child] = nil
                if ActiveCoroutines[child] then
                    coroutine.close(ActiveCoroutines[child])
                    ActiveCoroutines[child] = nil
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    local function processQueue()
        local currentTime = tick()
        while #messageQueue > 0 and currentTime - messageQueue[1] > timeWindow do
            table.remove(messageQueue, 1)
        end
    end

    TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
        if message.TextSource and message.TextSource.UserId ~= player.UserId then
            local text = message.Text

            processQueue()
            if #messageQueue < messageLimit and Annoying == true then
                table.insert(messageQueue, tick())
                if chatChannel then
                    chatChannel:SendAsync(string.format('"%s" ' .. AnnoyInput, text))
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local function handleInput()

        if not character then
            return

        local tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
        if not tool then
            return
        end

        local glove = tool:FindFirstChild("Glove")
        if not glove then
            return
        end

        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then
            return
        end

        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then
            return
        end

        local animation = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(tool.Name == "Dual" and "DualSlap" or "Slap")

            return
        end

        local animationTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        animationTrack:Play()
    end

    ToggleSA = SlapsSection:AddToggle("Slap Aura Searcher", {
        Title = "Slap Aura",
        Description = "Not all gloves are supported.",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(state)
            local slapamountantikick = 0
            local currentRemoteEvent = nil
            local playerDebounces = {}
            local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

            local function removeslapantikickafter1s()
                slapamountantikick = slapamountantikick - 1
            end

            if heartbeatConnection then
                heartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
                heartbeatConnection = nil
            end

            if state then
                isDetectionEnabled = true

                local gloveValue = player.leaderstats
                    and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Glove")
                    and player.leaderstats.Glove.Value
                local foundRemote = false
                if gloveValue then
                    if gloveValue == "Extended" then
                        detectionRadius = 25
                    end
                    if gloveHits[gloveValue] then
                        currentRemoteEvent = gloveHits[gloveValue]
                        foundRemote = true
                    else
                        for _, remote in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage:GetChildren()) do
                            if
                                remote:IsA("RemoteEvent")
                                and string.match(string.lower(remote.Name), string.lower(gloveValue) .. "h?t$")
                            then
                                currentRemoteEvent = remote
                                foundRemote = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not foundRemote then
                    isDetectionEnabled = false
                    Window:Dialog({
                        Title = "This glove is not supported.",
                        Content = "Report this in Feedback or in the Discord.",
                        Buttons = { { Title = "Got it" } },
                    })
                    ToggleSA:SetValue(false)
                    return
                end

                if displayvisually then
                    createVisualCircle()
                end

                heartbeatConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not isDetectionEnabled then
                        return
                    end
                    local hrp = getHumanoidRootPart()
                    if not hrp or not currentRemoteEvent then
                        return
                    end

                    if displayvisually then
                        updateVisualCircle()
                    end

                    if
                        GloveNecessary and not (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool"))
                    then
                        return
                    end

                    for _, target in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if target ~= player and not playerDebounces[target.Name] then
                            local tgtHRP = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if tgtHRP then
                                local distance = (tgtHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

                                if
                                    tonumber(distance) <= tonumber(detectionRadius)
                                    and slapamountantikick < slapamountantikickmaxed
                                then
                                    if ToggleFriendsSlapAura and player:IsFriendsWith(target.UserId) then
                                        continue
                                    end
                                    if target.Character:FindFirstChild("Reversed") then
                                        continue
                                    end
                                    local vuln = target.Character:FindFirstChild("TSVulnerability")
                                    if not (vuln and vuln.Value) or target.Character:FindFirstChild("rock") then
                                        continue
                                    end
                                    local arena = target.Character:FindFirstChild("isInArena")
                                    if not (arena and arena.Value) then
                                        continue
                                    end
                                    if
                                        not target.leaderstats
                                        or target.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Glove").Value == "Spectator"
                                    then
                                        continue
                                    end

                                    playerDebounces[target.Name] = true
                                    slapamountantikick = slapamountantikick + 1
                                    currentRemoteEvent:FireServer(tgtHRP)

                                    local delay1, delay2 = 0.08, 0.08
                                    if
                                        target.Character:FindFirstChild("FakePart Right Leg")
                                        or (target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") and target.Character.Torso:FindFirstChild(
                                            "a0"
                                        ))
                                        or target.leaderstats.Glove.Value == "Ultra Instinct"
                                    then
                                        delay1, delay2 = 1.6, 2.9
                                    end
                                    task.delay(delay1, function()
                                        playerDebounces[target.Name] = nil
                                        task.delay(delay2, removeslapantikickafter1s)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            else
                isDetectionEnabled = false
                if heartbeatConnection then
                    heartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
                    heartbeatConnection = nil
                end
                if visualPart then
                    visualPart:Destroy()
                    visualPart = nil
                end
            end
        end,
    })

    local function startFarm()
        local retryCount = 0
        local maxRetries = 40

        while isFarmRunning do
            local character = getCharacter()
            local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local part = nil
            for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Model") and string.match(child.Name, "^Å" .. game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name .. "$") then
                    part = child
                    break
                end
            end

            if part and part:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                game.ReplicatedStorage.b:FireServer(part.HumanoidRootPart)
                retryCount = 0
            else
                retryCount = retryCount + 1
            end

            if retryCount >= maxRetries then
                isFarmRunning = false
                Fluent:Notify({
                    Title = "Farm Stopped",
                    Content = "The farm has stopped because the clone did not exist.",
                    Duration = 5,
                })
                break
            end

            task.wait(0.01)

    local function startWalkFling()
        humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoidDiedConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                walkflinging = false
            end)
        end

        walkflinging = true

        coroutine.wrap(function()
            repeat
                game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
                local character = player.Character
                root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local vel, movel = nil, 0.1

                while not (character and character.Parent and root and root.Parent) do
                    game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
                    character = player.Character
                    root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                end

                vel = root.Velocity
                root.Velocity = vel * 1000000 + Vector3.new(0, 1000000, 0)

                game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Wait()
                if character and character.Parent and root and root.Parent then
                    root.Velocity = vel
                end

                game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Wait()
                if character and character.Parent and root and root.Parent then
                    root.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                    movel = movel * -1
                end
            until walkflinging == false
        end)()
    end

        walkflinging = false

            humanoidDiedConnection:Disconnect()
            humanoidDiedConnection = nil

    _G.originalTransparency = {}
    _G.originalCanCollide = {}

    _G.connections = {}
    function applyHitboxExtensionToCharacter(character)
        if not character then
            return
        end

        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            return
        end

        local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
        if player == game.Players.LocalPlayer then
            return
        end

        if not _G.originalSizes[hrp] then
            _G.originalSizes[hrp] = hrp.Size
            _G.originalTransparency[hrp] = hrp.Transparency
            _G.originalCanCollide[hrp] = hrp.CanCollide
        end

        hrp.CanCollide = false

        hrp.Transparency = 0.5

        local baseSize = _G.originalSizes[hrp]
        hrp.Size = baseSize * _G.HitboxExtensionMultiplier
    end

    function revertHitboxExtensionOfCharacter(character)
        if not character then
            return
        end

        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            return
        end

        local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
        if player == game.Players.LocalPlayer then
            return
        end

        if _G.originalSizes[hrp] then
            hrp.Transparency = 1

            hrp.Size = _G.originalSizes[hrp]

            hrp.CanCollide = false

            _G.originalSizes[hrp] = nil
            _G.originalTransparency[hrp] = nil
            _G.originalCanCollide[hrp] = nil
        else
            hrp.Transparency = 1
            hrp.CanCollide = true
        end
    end

    function applyToAllPlayers()
        for _, p in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character then
                applyHitboxExtensionToCharacter(p.Character)
            end

            if not _G.connections[p] then
                _G.connections[p] = p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
                    applyHitboxExtensionToCharacter(character)
                end)
            end
        end

        if not _G.connections["PlayerAdded"] then
            _G.connections["PlayerAdded"] = game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(newPlayer)
                _G.connections[newPlayer] = newPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
                    applyHitboxExtensionToCharacter(character)
                end)
            end)
        end
    end

    function revertFromAllPlayers()
        for key, conn in pairs(_G.connections) do
            if conn and conn.Disconnect then
                conn:Disconnect()
            end
            _G.connections[key] = nil
        end

        for _, p in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character then
                revertHitboxExtensionOfCharacter(p.Character)
            end
        end

        _G.originalSizes = {}
        _G.originalTransparency = {}
        _G.originalCanCollide = {}
    end
